title: NeurIPS Paper Checklist Guidelines

locator: items 4 Experimental Result Reproducibility, 5 Open Access to Data and Code, 6 Experimental Setting/Details, 8 Experiments Compute Resource, 12 Licenses

inspection_note: 實讀4–8及12項；列出模型存取或可重做入口、程式與資料、完整命令和環境、切分、超參數選擇、硬體／記憶體／時間。12項要求引用來源與版本、URL、授權名稱及遵守條件。支持本節紀錄欄位的目的，不保證僅有紀錄即可重現位元相同訓練。

title: CPython hashlib documentation
locator: Hash algorithms; Usage; sha256 and hexdigest
quote: At any point you can ask it for the digest of the concatenation of the data fed to it so far using the digest() or hexdigest() methods.
inspection_note: 實讀Hash algorithms與Usage，SHA256對輸入bytes計算digest；雜湊檔案內容不評估標籤、授權或模型正確性。指紋用於核對已取得內容；不解讀為由hash單獨下載檔案或絕對無碰撞證明。

title: Git core tutorial: committing Git state

title: scikit-learn Cross-validation: evaluating estimator performance
